_note: Routing catalog. The Router agent may only choose from these ids. Edit descriptions here, not in prompts.

departments.name: Deposit Operations
departments.owns: Checking and savings accounts: overdraft and NSF fees, maintenance fees, deposit holds, account opening/closing, statements, interest on deposits.

departments.name: Card Services
departments.owns: Debit and credit cards: declines, replacement cards, credit card billing and interest, credit limits, rewards. Not unauthorized charges (Fraud & Disputes).

departments.name: Fraud & Disputes
departments.owns: Unauthorized or disputed transactions, ATM cash not dispensed, scams, identity theft, account takeover, chargebacks, Zelle/P2P fraud.

departments.name: Consumer Lending
departments.owns: Auto loans, personal loans and lines of credit: applications, denials, rates, payments, payoff letters.

departments.name: Mortgage Servicing
departments.owns: Mortgage and HELOC payments, escrow, taxes and insurance, forbearance and modification, payoff, mortgage applications.

departments.name: Digital Banking
departments.owns: Mobile app and online banking: login, outages, bill pay, transfers that fail for technical reasons, alerts, mobile deposit.

departments.name: Branch & Contact Center
departments.owns: Staff conduct, wait times, branch hours or closures, phone hold times, service quality, ATM physical condition.

departments.name: Collections & Recoveries
departments.owns: Past-due accounts, collection calls and letters, payment plans, charge-offs, repossession.

departments.name: Privacy Office
departments.owns: Misdirected mail or statements, information disclosed to the wrong person, data-sharing and marketing opt-out requests.
